hero.headline: Handcrafted Resin Art
hero.subheadline: Each piece is a unique expression — shaped by hand, sealed in time.

title_section.title: Selected Collections
title_section.subtitle: A celebration of suspended moments, where organic forms merge with the fluid transparency of high-quality resin.

first.title: Ethereal Petals
first.description: Inspired by the ephemeral beauty of spring, this collection captures the delicate pulse of plant life. Each piece features a single hand-selected flower, preserved forever in a crystal embrace.

second.title: Ocean Depths
second.description: Intense cerulean pigments blend with translucent layers to mimic the rhythmic movement of the tide. A collection designed for those who find peace in the vastness of the sea.

first.title: Artisan Grade
first.description: Non-yellowing, high-clarity resin that protects the integrity of your pieces for years.

second.title: Selected Collections
second.description: We source our botanicals from local sustainable gardens and use bio-based resin components.

third.title: One of a Kind
third.description: Due to the hand-poured nature of resin, no two pieces will ever be identical.

title_section.title: Care & Handcrafting Times
title_section.subtitle: Artistry requires patience and intentionality. Each piece is a journey from liquid resin to a wearable treasure.

about.title: About the Studio
about.body: Every piece begins as an idea — a color, a feeling, a texture found in nature. We pour, cure, and finish each item by hand in our small studio.

contact.title: Let's connect
contact.subtitle: Write to us without rush — every message is read slowly, the way every piece is made.
